issue_context.title: br: parameter rename for ebs snapshot backup and restore
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report
current implement for ebs snapshot backup restore for tide-operator
```
br backup full --type=aws-ebs/gcp-ps // backup from various snapshot
br restore full --meta-phase // restore metadata
br restore full --data-phase // restore cluster data
```

suggest change to 
```
br backup full --type=aws-ebs/gcp-ps // backup from various snapshot
br restore full --type=aws-ebs --prepare // i.e. current phase one
br restore full --type=aws-ebs // restore cluster data
```

we would like to remove phase concepts for  the feature
Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

kubectl logs backup_pod

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
